logp.method_description: Partition coefficients (Pow) [100], were determined by the shake-flask method and UV–Vis measurements, according to a previously described procedure [44]. All operations were carried out at room temperature (ca. 21°C). Stock solutions were prepared in octanol-saturated water for [2,5,6]CF3SO3, in water-saturated octanol for [3]CF3SO3, and cis-E-[4]CF3SO3. The wavelength corresponding to a maximum shoulder absorption of each compound in the 350–420 nm range was used for UV–Vis quantitation. The procedure was repeated three times for each sample (from the same stock solution); results are given as mean ± standard deviation.
